construction.implementation_origin: Authored from scratch in the isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: Synthetic marker, ERP/MES work_orders with metric specifications, sensor_csv, inspections, feedback, products, customer
shared_schema.output: One JSON envelope containing schema_version, status, stage, synthetic, source, readings, quality_decisions, alerts, themes, search_results, onboarding
shared_schema.validation: Shared validate_input and validate_state layer rechecks provenance and deterministic derived output at every stage boundary. Strict units, finite numbers, timezone timestamps, unique IDs, references, tolerances and safety bounds. CSV requires timestamp,asset_id,work_order_id,metric,value,unit in that order.
shared_schema.errors: File, JSON and validation errors produce a single JSON object with status error and exit code 2.

cross_stage_handoffs.data: Validated normalized readings, attributable inspection decisions, human safety alerts and linked feedback
Work-order-scoped themes with explicit source evidence and counts augment customer query ranking
Compatible ranked products and theme references determine recommended product and personalized next steps; quality and safety records preserved

behavior.documents: Parse and normalize time-series CSV; reshape inspection measurements into inclusive-tolerance decisions with inspector, timestamp, work order, asset, units and rule version. Escalate safety-critical telemetry and inspection readings.
behavior.insights: Deterministic keyword/synonym theme aggregation over customer feedback, invented maintenance logs, quality failures and out-of-tolerance telemetry.
behavior.search: Deterministic synonym-expanded lexical ranking plus theme evidence; strict asset compatibility; stable product-ID tie breaks; top five positive matches.
behavior.onboard: Safety review first, then failed-quality disposition, experience-based orientation, and specialist product review or no-match clarification. No machine actuation.
behavior.fixtures: Explicitly synthetic, fictitious IDs and logs; random.Random(123) telemetry with injected plausible overtemperature anomaly.
behavior.traceability: Demonstrative ISO 9001-style quality-decision traceability; not a compliance certification.

included: Human escalation records and operational review gates
excluded: Real alert delivery or human approval workflow
